description: Shell script for testing 'git rev-list' handling of unexpected object types, including setup and validation of various object anomalies in a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs commands, and checks output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, captures output.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.
